name: Kaalaa Baunaa
bio: Archetype: ST DPT, AoE DPT, AP-Greedy. ⌽ Skills grant [Planet]s, passively increasing damage and other skill effects. ⌽ When [Planet]s are removed through Ult or cycled out, grants a stronger stack based buff. ⌽ S1 grants [Saturn], increasing Penetration Rate. ⌽ S2 grants [Mars], increasing Leech Rate. ⌽ Ult grants [Moon], increasing Incantation Might. ⌽ Ult removes all [Planet]s and gains an additional affect. depending on the highest type of [Planet] removed. ⌽ Damage relies on Ult cycling; very AP-Greedy.
